items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: I was in touch with maybe you’ve interviewed or for other projects George Schuller, his son, who is a great drummer and is also a kind of a keeper of the flame of the information of the Lenox jazz school

ctx.x: Is that – I won’t even say easier – more possible to pull off by articulating each note more than slurring.

Yes. This is a very good point. In the beginning I sounded very stiff and corny because the only way I could get the notes to come out just right was to tongue every note. So it would be like [scats] I would sound like a ‘20s band. [scats] even if I’m trying to play bebop. And oh I remember how there was this breakthrough somewhere in the end of freshman or sophomore year, around 19ish, 18ish or 19ish I realized wait a minute. If I can get that phrasing better and not have to tongue every note I will have made a…
